title: Sovereign Citizens Ep. 10: Gold Fringe and Admiralty Court | A Bit Too Much To Think
channel: A Bit Too Much To Think
summary: Debunks the gold-fringe admiralty-court theory using the flag code, Article III and a federal court order calling the argument frivolous.

assertions.quote: to think that a fringed flag adorning the courtroom somehow limits the this court's jurisdiction is frivolous
so although admiralty law is different the court trying the case is the same

verdicts.note: 28 U.S.C. 1333 gives admiralty jurisdiction to the federal district courts.

assertions.quote: green street's argument is entirely frivolous
